narration:1:1064301001:0.text: A mechanical messenger bearing an invitation whirs steadily as it sweeps overhead.
narration:1:1064301001:0.source_cn: 一个携带邀请函的机械信使划过低空，发出规律的嗡鸣

narration:2:1064301002:0.text: Across the barren mountain range below, ancient runes flicker faintly amid the desolation.
narration:2:1064301002:0.source_cn: 在它下方，是一片荒芜的山地，隐约间，可见古老的符文闪烁

narration:3:1064301003:0.text: Then, a gauntleted arm emerges from nowhere, seizing the messenger in an iron grip...
narration:3:1064301003:0.source_cn: 一只覆盖暗色金属甲胄的大手猛然从阴影中伸出，将机械信使...

say:7:1064301005:0.text: Gunnar removes the invitation from the messenger. Just as he is about to toss it aside, the word "weapon" makes him stop short.
say:7:1064301005:0.source_cn: 勒图姆摘下机械信使携带的邀请函，在丢弃之前，目光无意间...

say:9:1064301006:0.text: He unfolds the letter. Across the top, a bold heading reads: <style="highlight">Brimstone Village Weapon-Making Open Contest</style>.
say:9:1064301006:0.source_cn: 他展开邀请函，其正上方写着：<style=highli...

say:10:1064301007:0.text:
Note:
Contestants of all backgrounds are welcome. Only your skill will be judged.
say:10:1064301007:0.source_cn: 无限制一行注：\n不论参赛者出身如何，来自何方，武器锻...

say:11:1064301008:0.text:
Weapon-making. Contest.
A chance. To test my weapons.
say:11:1064301008:0.source_cn: 武器锻造，竞赛。\n火力，验证。

narration:14:1064301076:0.text: Brimstone Village square, buzzing with voices...

say:16:1064301009:0.text: Welcome to Brimstone Village, where the forges run around the clock! I'm your old friend, Gonrad!
say:16:1064301009:0.source_cn: 各位！欢迎来到深岩村，锻造炉火永不熄灭之地！我是你们的...

say:17:1064301010:0.text: The dwarves are honored to present Esperia's most inclusive <style="highlight">weapon-making contest</style>! Registration closes soon!
say:17:1064301010:0.source_cn: 由矮人一族举办，伊索米亚有史以来最开放、最自由的<st...

say:18:1064301011:0.text: Are you ready for this legendary contest? Let's make some noise!
say:18:1064301011:0.source_cn: 让我们用热情，点燃这传奇的序幕！

say:21:1064301012:0.text: Hey, big fellow, that old rifle of yours still looks as good as new!
say:21:1064301012:0.source_cn: 嘿，大个子，你带来的膛线可是个老设计了，不过保养得真不错。

say:22:1064301013:0.text: Madam, I can smell gunpowder on you from here. Be careful, alright?
say:22:1064301013:0.source_cn: 还有这位女士，我闻到你身上的火药味了，可要注意安全啊！

say:23:1064301014:0.text: Looks like we've got some tough competition this year. The dwarves had better bring our best!
say:23:1064301014:0.source_cn: 今年的选手藏龙卧虎，看来，冠军之争会很激烈，我们矮人一...

say:25:1064301015:0.text:
This is so... BORING!
Zanie, you promised this would be exciting! Watching a bunch of country bumpkins shove each other around is hardly my idea of fun!
say:25:1064301015:0.source_cn: 好——无——聊——啊！\n祖娅， 不是说会有热闹看嘛！...

say:26:1064301016:0.text: Patience. See that? Kornuk's been looking daggers at that bearfolk craftsman for quite a while now.
say:26:1064301016:0.source_cn: 别心急嘛，小丫头。喏，看那边，寇恩已经瞪了那个熊人工匠...

say:27:1064301017:0.text: I say they'll be at each other's throats in ten minutes. Want to bet on it?
say:27:1064301017:0.source_cn: 要不要打个赌，不出十分钟，他们就会吵起来。

say:28:1064301018:0.text:
I love drama! Where is it?!
Fight! Fight! Fight! Boomboom, who do you think will win?
say:28:1064301018:0.source_cn: 打架，哪，在哪在哪？！\n打起来！打起来！阿爆，你说谁会赢？

say:30:1064301019:0.text: Oh-ho! Both of them would cower in the almighty Lady Kulu's presence!
say:30:1064301019:0.source_cn: 哦哦哦，在无敌的、至尊的库露露大人面前，所有人都会望风而降！

say:31:1064301020:0.text: That's a fair point... Wait, hey! Boomboom, are you even listening to what I'm saying?!
say:31:1064301020:0.source_cn: 说得倒也不错……不对，啊喂，阿爆，你到底有没有在认真听...

say:35:1064301021:0.text: Zanie, we've got a problem! A strange guy showed up for the contest, but his name doesn't match the one on the invitation!
say:35:1064301021:0.source_cn: 祖娅！不好了！有个奇怪的家伙来参赛，但他和邀请函上的名...

say:36:1064301022:0.text: We tried reasoning with him, but he ignored us completely and kept pushing his way in!
say:36:1064301022:0.source_cn: 我们怎么劝他都不听，也不说话，非要往里进！

say:38:1064301023:0.text: Hmph. He's got some nerve causing trouble in Brimstone Village. Come on, take me to him.
say:38:1064301023:0.source_cn: 嘿，是哪个不长眼的家伙敢在深岩村的地盘上闹事，走，带我...

say:39:1064301024:0.text: From the lingering traces of the <style="highlight">abyss</style> on the invitation, Kulu realizes that a <style="highlight">Hypogean</style> must have come into contact with it.
say:39:1064301024:0.source_cn: 这时，库露露敏锐察觉到邀请函上散发着来自<style=...

say:42:1064301025:0.text: Hold on! Let me handle this! A small fry like him isn't worth your time, Zanie!
say:42:1064301025:0.source_cn: 等等等等！我去，让我去！这种小角色，哪用得着祖娅你出手...

say:43:1064301026:0.text: Well, well, miracles do happen! Since when did you become so helpful?
say:43:1064301026:0.source_cn: 啧啧，太阳打西边出来了，你什么时候这么热心肠了？

say:44:1064301027:0.text: Hey, helping has always come naturally to me. Besides, it's boring just sitting around. Isn't that right, Boomboom?
say:44:1064301027:0.source_cn: 我一直都很热心好不好！而且多无聊，找点事做嘛。阿爆，对不对？

say:46:1064301028:0.text: Absolutely! Lady Kulu is always willing to lend a hand! She's nothing like those other Hypogeans!
say:46:1064301028:0.source_cn: 没错，库露露大人向来以助人为乐，和那些落后的老派恶魔可...

say:47:1064301029:0.text: Fine, go ahead. I'd better stay here and make sure things don't turn ugly between those two.
say:47:1064301029:0.source_cn: 行吧，你去就你去。正好我还得留在这里监场，免得那两个家...

say:48:1064301030:0.text: But if that strange guy turns out to be too much to handle, just give me a shout. I'll be right over.
say:48:1064301030:0.source_cn: 不过，要是对方真是个来闹事的硬茬子，别逞强，喊一声我就过来。

say:49:1064301031:0.text:
Trust me, I've got this.
Come on, Boomboom. Take me there!
say:49:1064301031:0.source_cn: 放心啦，交涉可是我的强项。\n走，阿爆，带路！

say:50:1064301032:0.text: Yes, Lady Kulu! This way, please!

say:54:1064301033:0.text:
Screw breech, composite magazine, all-metal barrel...
Everything checks out.
say:54:1064301033:0.source_cn: 螺式炮闩、聚合弹鼓、全金属膛管……\n军械，全备。

say:57:1064301034:0.text: As Kulu creeps up behind Gunnar...
say:57:1064301034:0.source_cn: 库露露轻手轻脚地接近勒图姆，突然……

say:59:1064301035:0.text: Suddenly, a bomb comes hurtling straight at her!
say:59:1064301035:0.source_cn: 一枚炮弹毫无预兆地向她袭来！

say:62:1064301036:0.text: In the nick of time, Boomboom balloons in size, opens its mouth wide, and swallows the bomb.
say:62:1064301036:0.source_cn: 库露露身边的阿爆急速膨胀，张开大嘴，一口将炮弹吞下。

say:64:1064301038:0.text:
Oh, my! Boomboom, are you okay?!
What's your problem, Metalhead? I didn't mess with you! Are you looking for a fight?!
say:64:1064301038:0.source_cn: 啊啊啊，阿爆你没事吧？！\n你你你，哪来的铁块头，我又...

say:65:1064301039:0.text: Ugh... Gugu... I-I need some time to digest this, Lady Kulu...
say:65:1064301039:0.source_cn: 呃……咕……主人，我、我得消化一下……

say:66:1064301040:0.text: Gunnar takes two steps forward for a closer look at Boomboom. The ground quivers slightly beneath his heavy footsteps.
say:66:1064301040:0.source_cn: 勒图姆向前走了两步，沉重的脚步让地面微微震动，他仔细打...

say:67:1064301041:0.text: Say something! Don't think you can get away with this by playing dumb, Metalhead!
say:67:1064301041:0.source_cn: 别以为装傻不说话就没事了，铁块头！

say:69:1064301043:1.text: Stop! I don't go by that name anymore! It's Lady Kulu now!
say:69:1064301043:1.source_cn: 住口！我早就不是过去那家伙了！现在的是新生的、伟大的库...

say:70:1064301044:1.text: Boomboom, are you done eating? Time to knock some sense into this arrogant fool!
say:70:1064301044:1.source_cn: 阿爆，调整好了就上，给这个目中无人的家伙一点颜色瞧瞧！

say:71:1064301045:1.text: *Burp* Lady Kulu, I-I... am ready for action.
say:71:1064301045:1.source_cn: 嗝——主人，我、我……随时准备出击。

say:72:1064301046:1.text:
My idol! Perfect!
Powerful bombs! Blow everything up!
say:72:1064301046:1.source_cn: 偶像，完美！\n强劲炸弹，荡平一切！

say:73:1064301047:1.text:
What? Hold it for a second, Boomboom...
Hey, Metalhead, did you just say something about your idol? Who's that?
say:73:1064301047:1.source_cn: 欸，等等，阿爆你先别动……\n铁块头，你刚刚说偶像、完...

say:75:1064301049:1.text: How dare you address Lady Kulu by her name!
say:75:1064301049:1.source_cn: 大胆，竟敢直呼库露露大人的名讳……

say:76:1064301050:1.text: Forget it, Boomboom. He doesn't seem to have much going on upstairs.
say:76:1064301050:1.source_cn: 算了算了，阿爆，这铁块头的脑子好像不太聪明。

say:77:1064301051:1.text: Since we both share a love of bombs, I'm going to let this slide. Just remember to call me Lady Kulu from now on!
say:77:1064301051:1.source_cn: 不过，看你也是个懂火力的家伙嘛，就不跟你计较了。以后得...

say:78:1064301052:1.text: Besides coming here to see me, why did you show up with someone else's invitation?
say:78:1064301052:1.source_cn: 说吧，除了见偶像以外，到这儿来干嘛，还拿着别人的邀请函...

say:79:1064301053:1.text:
Open contest.
Good chance. Test my weapons.
say:79:1064301053:1.source_cn: 竞赛，无限制。\n顶级火力，验证。

say:80:1064301054:1.text: What... You came all this way just to see if you can beat the dwarves and humans at making weapons? Hahaha! Well, I suppose that's a good enough reason.
say:80:1064301054:1.source_cn: 噗……你想跟那些矮人、人类比做武器？哈哈哈！勉强说得过去。

say:81:1064301055:1.text: Anyway, that shot you took at me earlier really, really got under my skin.
say:81:1064301055:1.source_cn: 不过，你刚才轰我那一炮，让我很不爽。非常、非常不爽。

say:82:1064301056:1.text: You've got to make it up to me somehow. You know, the way we do things back home.
say:82:1064301056:1.source_cn: 按照我们那儿的规矩，你得赔点好处，让我心情好受些，才能...

say:83:1064301057:1.text: Gunnar stares at Kulu dazedly, apparently failing to grasp what she means.
say:83:1064301057:1.source_cn: 勒图姆沉默地看着库露露，似乎不明白她所说的规矩是什么。

say:84:1064301058:1.text: Seriously, are you really one of us? You don't seem to know much besides fighting. Don't worry, I'm not taking your stuff for free. In return, I'll get your registration sorted out.
say:84:1064301058:1.source_cn: 你到底是不是我们那儿的，怎么除了打架什么都不懂。我可不...

say:85:1064301059:1.text: And I'm the only one who can help you. See that scary-looking dwarf lady over there? If she finds out there's a Hypogean among the contestants, you're done for. Trust me, she hits hard.
say:85:1064301059:1.source_cn: 不然，外面那个矮人老阿姨，要是她知道混进来一个恶魔——...

say:86:1064301060:1.text:
Your bomb. Can be optimized.
Explosive energy. Unstable.
say:86:1064301060:1.source_cn: 你的炸弹，吞能上限，可优化。\n爆炸能量，易失衡。

say:87:1064301061:1.text:
More powerful. After modification.
I prepare materials.
say:87:1064301061:1.source_cn: 改装，火力升级。\n材料，我自备。

say:88:1064301062:1.source_cn: 啧啧，免费给我升级炸弹？

say:89:1064301063:1.text: Sounds good. Just remember, I want my bomb to be both practical and stylish. Use the finest materials you can find!
say:89:1064301063:1.source_cn: 听起来不赖，不过得改时髦点，时髦，你懂吗？得用最好的材...

say:90:1064301064:1.text: By the way, what's your name? If you don't honor your deal, I'll hunt you down in the abyss!
say:90:1064301064:1.source_cn: 还有，你叫什么来着？要是你赖账，我好去深渊下面找你！

say:92:1064301066:0.text: That's a pretty cool name... Now stay here, keep a low profile, and try not to blow up everything in sight.
say:92:1064301066:0.source_cn: 名字挺有派头的嘛……你就在这待着吧，低调点，别动不动就开炮！

say:96:1064301067:1.text: Back already?! So, what's the deal with that guy? I hope he didn't give you too much trouble.
say:96:1064301067:1.source_cn: 这么快就回来啦。怎么样，是哪里来的家伙，没有碰到棘手的...

say:97:1064301068:1.text: Who am I? The great Lady Kulu! There's no problem I can't solve!
say:97:1064301068:1.source_cn: 那还用说，无敌的本大人出马，问题当然圆满解决咯！

say:98:1064301069:1.text: Turns out he was disfigured in a workshop accident, and he's been a little eccentric ever since. As for the invitation, he got it from a friend who couldn't make it today.
say:98:1064301069:1.source_cn: 是个工坊出过事故的工匠，脸毁容了，性格就有点古怪。邀请...

say:99:1064301070:1.text: This is a weapon-making contest, not a beauty pageant. Who cares what he looks like?
say:99:1064301070:1.source_cn: 反正是比拼武器制造嘛，又不是选美，长成什么样有什么关系。

say:100:1064301071:1.text: That's it? It's not like you to defend a stranger for no reason.
say:100:1064301071:1.source_cn: 就这么简单？帮陌生人说好话，可不常见呢。

say:101:1064301072:1.text: Okay, okay, I know I can't hide anything from you. Truth is, he offered to help me upgrade my bomb.
say:101:1064301072:1.source_cn: 哎呀，就知道瞒不了你。他给了我点好处，帮我改造了个小玩意儿。

say:102:1064301073:1.text: So I agreed to help him sort things out in return. What can I say? I'm a Hypogean with a heart, you know.
say:102:1064301073:1.source_cn: 作为具有感恩之心的恶魔，我就只好帮帮他咯。

say:103:1064301074:1.text:
Honestly, I don't know what to do when you're this forthright.
But if he causes any trouble in Brimstone Village...
say:103:1064301074:1.source_cn: 怎么能这么直白地就说出来，真是拿你没办法。\n丑话说在...

say:104:1064301075:1.text: Relax, he's too chicken to try anything funny. Alright, I've got places to be. Catch you later!
say:104:1064301075:1.source_cn: 放心吧，他胆子小得很，不敢乱来的！就这样，我还有事呢，...

say:2:1064302001:0.text:
Welcome, friends from near and far! Thank you for joining us here today!
The results are in! Congratulations to the sixteen craftsmen who have qualified for <style="highlight">Round One</style>!
say:2:1064302001:0.source_cn: 各位远道而来的朋友！欢迎来到比赛现场！\n经过严格的资...

say:3:1064302002:0.text:
A harsh challenge awaits them!
Please listen carefully to the rules. Contestants, you'll have one day to build a <style="highlight">repeating firearm</style> using the <style="highlight">materials we've prepared</style> for you.
say:3:1064302002:0.source_cn: 他们将迎来严酷的考验——车轮战！\n请听清规则！各位参...

say:4:1064302003:0.text: At the end of the day, your firearms will be put to the test. The four contestants whose weapons punch through the greatest number of targets will move on to the next round!
say:4:1064302003:0.source_cn: 一天后，评委们将使用参赛者制作的火铳，射击多重标靶。穿...

say:5:1064302004:0.source_cn: 现在，我宣布——比赛，正式开始！

say:7:1064302005:0.text: As the contest kicks off, the contestants head to their workshops and get straight to work.
say:7:1064302005:0.source_cn: 随着比赛开始，参赛者们纷纷起身走进自己的工坊，开始时间...

say:9:1064302006:0.text: Only four get through? In previous years, half the field would advance.
say:9:1064302006:0.source_cn: 首轮竟然只有四个晋级名额，往年可都是晋级一半人呢。

say:10:1064302007:0.text: <style="highlight">Those spots are going to us dwarves anyway. Our craftsmen already knew what the challenge would be</style>. That's the beauty of home-field advantage.

say:11:1064302008:0.text: Shush, not so loud. Someone might hear you.
say:11:1064302008:0.source_cn: 嘘，小点声，别被其他人给听到了。

say:15:1064302009:0.text: Ahhh! I'm so mad! So, so mad! This is so wrong!
say:15:1064302009:0.source_cn: 啊啊啊——我生气了，我生气了！不允许，绝对不允许！

say:18:1064302011:0.text: Hey, can you put that scrap down and listen to me for a minute?!
say:18:1064302011:0.source_cn: 喂，别弄你那些破铜烂铁了！你就一点不好奇我在说什么？！

say:20:1064302013:0.text: You know what I just heard? <style="highlight">Some of the dwarf contestants already knew what the first challenge was. They even built their guns ahead of time</style>!

say:21:1064302014:0.text: This is blatant cheating! So unfair! They set the rules, yet they're not even following them!
say:21:1064302014:0.source_cn: 这是作弊！不公平！他们自己定的规矩，自己都不遵守！

say:22:1064302015:0.text: This is disgraceful, even by Hypogean standards!
say:22:1064302015:0.source_cn: 连我这样邪恶、不讲原则的大恶魔都看不下去了，这些关系户...

say:23:1064302016:1.text: If I were allowed to compete, I'd build the most spectacle bomb in history and blast those cheaters to bits!
say:23:1064302016:1.source_cn: 要不是比赛规则不允许，我一定要做一个堂堂正正的大炸弹，...

say:25:1064302017:0.text: Um... Lady Kulu, I believe you mean "spectacular"... Never mind.
say:25:1064302017:0.source_cn: 呃……库露露大人，您想说的是史无前例吧……算了算了。

say:26:1064302018:0.text:
Spectacular, supreme, uh... whatever.
One way or another, I'll teach them a lesson!
say:26:1064302018:0.source_cn: 史无前例，史上第一，史……呃……\n总之，一定要让这些...

say:27:1064302019:0.text: Hey Metalhead, you're being awfully quiet. Do you think I'm making this up?
say:27:1064302019:0.source_cn: 啊喂，铁块头，你一直不说话是什么意思！难道你不相信我？

say:28:1064302020:0.text:
Human rules. Meaningless.
Hypogeans. Destroy everything.
say:28:1064302020:0.source_cn: 人类规则，无用。\n恶魔，用火力，湮灭一切。

say:29:1064302021:0.text:
You're right! I'm a Hypogean! Why should I play by the rules?
Shoot, I think I'm slowly turning into a boring old stickler...
say:29:1064302021:0.source_cn: 对哦，我是恶魔，干嘛要守死规矩！\n怎么回事，我差点变...

say:30:1064302022:1.text: Hey, Metalhead! Are you done upgrading my bomb yet?
say:30:1064302022:1.source_cn: 喂，铁块头，我的炸弹改装得怎么样了？我现在就要验货！

say:31:1064302023:1.text: The moment bombs are mentioned, Gunnar visibly perks up and lets out an excited hiss.
say:31:1064302023:1.source_cn: 说到炸弹改装，勒图姆似乎来了兴趣，身体迸发出兴奋的蒸汽声。

say:32:1064302024:0.text:
Energy capacity. Blast power. Upgraded.
Perfect. Ready for testing.
say:32:1064302024:0.source_cn: 吞能上限、爆发能量，强化。\n完美。可试爆。

say:33:1064302025:0.text:
Hee-hee, just what I was hoping for!
I bet those <style="highlight">pre-made firearms are already sitting in the weapon warehouse</style> now.

say:34:1064302026:0.text: Boomboom, let's <style="highlight">blow up that warehouse. Those shameless cheaters are going to pay for their actions!</style>

say:35:1064302027:0.text: Yes, Lady Kulu! Oh ho, I can't wait to see your new bomb in action!
say:35:1064302027:0.source_cn: 是！吼吼，伟大的库露露大人的无敌炸弹就要现世了！

say:37:1064302029:0.text: Behold the art of explosions, perfected by Lady Kulu!
say:37:1064302029:0.source_cn: 既然你替本大人升级了火力，那就让你亲眼瞧瞧，什么叫做偶...

narration:39:1064302030:0.text: Brimstone Village grows quiet at night, with only the distant ring of hammers echoing from the contestants' workshops.
narration:39:1064302030:0.source_cn: 夜幕降临，深岩村已然宁静，只有工坊方向还隐约传来参赛者...

say:42:1064302031:0.text: Suddenly, a deafening explosion shatters the peace. Flames and smoke engulf the village as cries of alarm erupt from the panicked dwarves...
say:42:1064302031:0.source_cn: 忽然，震耳欲聋的爆炸声撕裂夜空，火光与浓烟弥漫……矮人...

say:44:1064302032:0.text: What happened?! That sounded like a massive explosion!
say:44:1064302032:0.source_cn: 怎么回事？！怎么会有这么剧烈的爆炸！

say:45:1064302033:0.text: Ramsey, gather a team and go. Tell everyone the contest is off, then get them out of the village.
say:45:1064302033:0.source_cn: 拉齐，多带几个人，立刻宣布比赛中止，组织所有人撤离深岩村。

say:47:1064302034:0.text: B-But this is only Round One! If we cancel the whole thing now, all our hard work will go down the drain!
say:47:1064302034:0.source_cn: 可、可是这才到第一场比赛，要是就这么停了，之前的投入可...

say:48:1064302035:0.text: Safety comes first! We can always hold the event another time. Now go!
say:48:1064302035:0.source_cn: 安全第一！比赛还能再办，村子毁了就什么都没了！快去！

say:50:1064302036:0.text: Meanwhile, two young dwarf contestants make a dash for the burning warehouse, only to be stopped by Zanie.
say:50:1064302036:0.source_cn: 就在这时，两名年轻的矮人参赛者试图冲向起火仓库，被祖娅...

say:52:1064302037:0.text: Zanie recognizes them. <style="highlight">Their father is a famous craftsman in the village</style>.

say:53:1064302038:0.text: Stop, both of you! It's too dangerous in there!
say:53:1064302038:0.source_cn: 你们，停停停！里面很危险！

say:54:1064302039:0.text: Hurry and put out the fire! We've got stuff in there for tomorrow...
say:54:1064302039:0.source_cn: 快救火啊！里面还有……还有明天要用的……

say:55:1064302040:0.text: Oh, no! There's something important in the warehouse!
say:55:1064302040:0.source_cn: 完了完了！我们的……是放第一轮参赛武器的仓库！里面有重...

say:56:1064302041:0.text: Huh? I thought that warehouse was empty...
say:56:1064302041:0.source_cn: 重要物资？那间仓库不是空的吗？难道我记错了……

say:57:1064302042:0.text: The explosion comes to an abrupt halt amid the chaos.
say:57:1064302042:0.source_cn: 没等祖娅说完，在一片混乱中，爆炸毫无预兆地戛然而止。

say:58:1064302043:0.text:
Stay put, everyone! The danger isn't over yet.
I'll have my mechanical helper locate the source of the explosion. Once I've taken stock of the situation, I'll let everyone know whether the village is safe.
say:58:1064302043:0.source_cn: 大家先暂时留在原地，爆炸仍有可能再次出现。\n等机械助...

say:59:1064302044:0.text: The footage sent back by the mechanical helper reveals enormous craters gouged into the ground. Even someone as experienced as Zanie has never witnessed an explosion of this magnitude.
say:59:1064302044:0.source_cn: 片刻后，机械助手传回沿途爆炸影像，爆炸造成了一道道巨型...

say:60:1064302045:0.text: The mechanical assistant presses on and soon identifies the <style="highlight">weapon warehouse as the source of the explosion</style>.
say:60:1064302045:0.source_cn: 机械助手继续向前，很快找到<style=highlig...

say:61:1064302046:0.text: The warehouse is littered with shattered firearms, some of which are still exploding from the intense heat.
say:61:1064302046:0.source_cn: 仓库内，散落着不少被炸成残骸的火铳碎片，有些还在因为高...

say:62:1064302047:0.text:
This doesn't make sense... <style="highlight">The contest has only just started. There shouldn't be any finished firearms in the warehouse yet.</style>
... That leaves only one explanation...

say:63:1064302048:0.text: Zanie casts a suspicious glance at the two young dwarves she stopped earlier. They avoid her gaze, looking obviously guilty.
say:63:1064302048:0.source_cn: 祖娅若有所思地看向两个被他拦下来的矮人，后者不敢直视她...

say:64:1064302049:0.text: I think I know what's going on here... You brought finished firearms with you and passed them off as your own work! Your father tipped you off beforehand, didn't he? That little rascal...
say:64:1064302049:0.source_cn: 我明白了！你们竟然破坏规则，提前备赛！是你们老爸泄的题...

say:67:1064302052:0.text: Hmph. Both of you are out of the competition and banned from participating for the next two years!
say:67:1064302052:0.source_cn: 哼，你们不用再参加接下来的比赛了，明年，还有后年的参赛...

say:68:1064302053:0.text: You're cleaning up this mess, and when you're done, come to see me with a fifty-thousand-word report! And don't forget to bring your father with you!
say:68:1064302053:0.source_cn: 这里的烂摊子交给你们，收拾好以后，带着五万字检讨来找我...

say:69:1064302054:0.text: Zanie summons her mechanical helper and strides off without looking back. The other dwarves choose to put out the fire and conceal the evidence instead of investigating the cause of the explosion.
say:69:1064302054:0.source_cn: 祖娅收回机械助手，头也不回地离开了现场。余下的矮人面面...

say:74:1064302055:0.text:
Are you CRAZY?!
What on earth did you do to my bomb?!
say:74:1064302055:0.source_cn: 你——你你你你你这个神经病！\n你把本大人的炸弹改装成...

say:75:1064302056:1.text: Had Lady Kulu not stopped the secondary explosions in time, Brimstone Village would've been reduced to dust!
say:75:1064302056:1.source_cn: 要不是库露露大人及时制止了余爆，深岩村都要被炸光光了！

say:77:1064302058:0.text:
Fine, I see your point of view, but this is my bomb!
You should've told me what you changed! <style="highlight">I had no idea my bomb could be this destructive</style>!
say:77:1064302058:0.source_cn: 话是这么说没错，但这是我的炸弹！\n你得跟我说清楚改装...

say:79:1064302060:0.text: Come on, don't give me that face! If anyone should be sulking, it's me!
say:79:1064302060:0.source_cn: 啊喂，别摆出那副样子，该委屈的是本大人！

say:80:1064302061:0.text:
Firepower is everything!
Kulusta. Too many rules. Like humans. Not cool.
say:80:1064302061:0.source_cn: 火力至上！\n库露丝塔，规矩，很多。像人类，不酷。

say:81:1064302062:0.text: How rude! That's no way to speak to the great Lady Kulu!
say:81:1064302062:0.source_cn: 放肆！怎么跟尊贵的库露露大人讲话的？！

say:82:1064302063:1.text:
*Cough* Well, human rules have their merits!
If you weren't my fan, I'd have kicked you out long ago!
say:82:1064302063:1.source_cn: 咳咳，人类的规矩偶尔也有点道理！\n要不是因为你是我的...

say:83:1064302064:0.text: Exactly! Count yourself lucky that Lady Kulu has such a big heart!
say:83:1064302064:0.source_cn: 没错！庆幸库露露大人具有如此开阔的心胸吧，你这个脑子里...

say:85:1064302066:0.text: ... Tsk, I'm not wasting my time arguing with a dummy like you.
say:85:1064302066:0.source_cn: ……算了算了。我就不跟你这个笨蛋铁块头计较了。

say:86:1064302067:0.text: Next time you want to do anything to my stuff, RUN. IT. BY. ME. FIRST.
say:86:1064302067:0.source_cn: 总之，下次动我的东西之前，先——找——我——说——清——楚！

say:88:1064302068:0.text: Gunnar ignores Kulu's warning and turns his attention to a large-caliber cannon barrel.
say:88:1064302068:0.source_cn: 勒图姆对库露露的话置若罔闻，转身端详一根大口径炮管去了。

say:89:1064302069:0.text: Hey! You're not listening to a word I'm saying, are you?!

say:1:1064303001:0.text:
The stands are overflowing with eager spectators, their excitement making the atmosphere even livelier than yesterday.
The real-time leaderboard is displayed on a massive magical projection for all to see.
say:1:1064303001:0.source_cn: 看台人声鼎沸，气氛较昨日更为热烈。\n巨大的魔法投影清...

say:2:1064303002:0.text: Topping the leaderboard is the Trampler, a massive-caliber repeating firearm. The figure beside it represents the number of targets it penetrated in succession, and it far surpasses that of the runner-up.
say:2:1064303002:0.source_cn: 名为践踏者的巨型口径连发火铳影像高悬榜首，其后是连续穿...

say:5:1064303003:0.text: Ladies and gentlemen! Although Round One is still underway, I'd like to shine the spotlight on the dark horse currently leading the competition!
say:5:1064303003:0.source_cn: 女士们，先生们！首日车轮战的硝烟尚未散尽，一匹黑马已横...

say:6:1064303004:0.text:
This mysterious craftsman has turned the supplies we provided into a true work of art!
Can you believe it? The Trampler pierced through thirty-five targets in a single shot! That's a whopping five times the runner-up's score!
say:6:1064303004:0.source_cn: 一位神秘锻造大师，用主办方提供的标准材料，打造出了这把...

say:7:1064303005:0.text: It's a masterpiece by the mysterious craftsman from Workshop Eight!
say:7:1064303005:0.source_cn: 让我们记住这个编号——第八号工坊，它属于神秘锻造大师。

say:10:1064303006:1.text: Who's in Workshop Eight? I've never heard of anyone that good!
say:10:1064303006:1.source_cn: 八号，到底是谁？从没听说过有这么厉害的家伙！

say:11:1064303007:0.text: The design of that gun is insane! I've never seen anything like it. Is it possible it was made with some forbidden technique?
say:11:1064303007:0.source_cn: 看那火铳的结构，太狂野了！根本不是常规设计！不会是用了...

say:12:1064303008:0.text: Uncovering talents like this is exactly why we hold this contest! Now, we move to <style="highlight">Round Two</style>, the brutal knockout stage!
say:12:1064303008:0.source_cn: 黑马的诞生令人兴奋，但大赛还将继续！现在，我将宣布<s...

say:13:1064303009:0.text:
All contestants will have one day to <style="highlight">enchant a melee weapon</style>!
At the end of the round, our staff will activate your enchanted weapons and assess their effects.

say:14:1064303010:1.text: Winners will advance to the next round. As for losers... better luck next year!
say:14:1064303010:1.source_cn: 胜者晋级，败者……很遗憾，只能预祝下一届好运了！

say:16:1064303011:0.text: The audience erupts in rapturous cheers. After all, one-on-one knockout matches are far more thrilling than the individual evaluations of Round One.
say:16:1064303011:0.source_cn: 观众们发出更激烈的欢呼，一对一淘汰制，远比第一场集体测...

say:20:1064303012:0.text: Elsewhere, Kulu fiddles with a communicator, from which Gonrad's booming voice rings out.
say:20:1064303012:0.source_cn: 库露露摆弄着魔法传讯装置，装置中传出主持人冈罗洪亮的声音。

say:21:1064303013:0.text:
Hmm, enchanting a melee weapon?
No explosions? Just chopping and slashing? How lame.
say:21:1064303013:0.source_cn: 唔，附魔冷兵器？\n不能爆炸，就是砍来砍去的，多老土啊。

say:22:1064303014:0.text: Whoever came up with this challenge must be a boring old codger. No explosions, no fun!
say:22:1064303014:0.source_cn: 想出这道比赛题目的评委一定是个无聊的老家伙，要我说，就...

say:25:1064303016:0.text:
Energy in runes. Volatile.
Compressed energy. Highly unstable.
say:25:1064303016:0.source_cn: 附魔魔纹，易波动。\n能量压缩，高度失控风险。

say:27:1064303018:0.text: Wow, didn't know you could talk that much, Metalhead!
say:27:1064303018:0.source_cn: 啧啧啧，难得见你说这么多话嘛，铁块头！

say:28:1064303019:0.text: Tell me—how do my bombs measure up to enchanted weapons like those?
say:28:1064303019:0.source_cn: 那你再说说，那个附魔什么什么的，和本偶像轰轰烈烈的爆炸...

say:31:1064303021:0.source_cn: 停停，阿爆，让铁块头自己说！

say:33:1064303023:0.text:
More runic energy, more force needed for compression.
High risk.
say:33:1064303023:0.source_cn: 魔纹能量每提升一次，所需压制力倍增。\n高风险。

say:34:1064303024:0.text: But only one day is given.

say:35:1064303025:0.text: You didn't answer my question directly! But fine, I get your point.
say:35:1064303025:0.source_cn: 还是没有说嘛！不过听起来稍微有那么一丢丢意思了！

say:39:1064303026:0.text: The dark horse from Workshop Eight will be up against Bowa Ironhoof, a seasoned craftsman and one of our own!
say:39:1064303026:0.source_cn: 第八号工坊的黑马选手，对阵的是，来自深岩村的，资深工匠...

say:40:1064303027:0.text: Bowa is known for his masterful skills... and his weapon factory!
say:40:1064303027:0.source_cn: 博瓦以其精湛的锻造技艺和……独有的标准化生产线而闻名！

say:42:1064303028:0.text: It's Bowa! His factory gives him a huge advantage. He can forge an entire batch of weapons from the same mold and simply pick the best one.
say:42:1064303028:0.source_cn: 是博瓦！他的生产线太作弊了！听说在制好模具后，能集中生...

say:44:1064303029:0.text: Looks like this dark horse's run ends here. He probably made it this far through sheer luck.
say:44:1064303029:0.source_cn: 这匹黑马看来要止步于此了。不过本来也只是个毫无名气的小...

say:48:1064303030:0.text: Hmph! Why does everyone think you'll lose? What's so special about this Bowa guy? Mass production is a lousy, outdated method!
say:48:1064303030:0.source_cn: 哼！凭什么觉得你会输，那个博瓦有什么了不起的！不就是有...

say:49:1064303031:0.text: Exactly! How could a fan of Lady Kulu possibly lose to a small-timer like that?
say:49:1064303031:0.source_cn: 就是就是！库露露大人的粉丝怎么可能输给那种土包子！

say:50:1064303032:1.text:
Efficient production. Keep the best.
Good method.
say:50:1064303032:1.source_cn: 高效生产，优中选优。\n方法，合理。

say:51:1064303033:0.text: Hey, whose side are you on? Don't sell yourself short!
say:51:1064303033:0.source_cn: 喂，你还在帮对手说话？你到底哪边的？

say:52:1064303034:0.text:
My factory. Huge!
In the abyss.
say:52:1064303034:0.source_cn: 我的生产线，规模恢弘！\n就在，深渊之下。

say:53:1064303035:0.text: You have a factory too? Does that mean you can churn out all sorts of beautiful bombs like a candy factory?
say:53:1064303035:0.source_cn: 你也有生产线？哇！那不是可以像做糖果一样，哗啦啦地生产...

say:55:1064303037:0.text: Whoa, sounds great! Let's go... Eh, hold on...
say:55:1064303037:0.source_cn: 欸！欸欸欸！那我们快……不对……

say:56:1064303038:0.text: How can you make use of your factory when it's all the way down in the abyss?
say:56:1064303038:0.source_cn: 生产线在深渊下面，我们又搬不过来。说了等于白说嘛！

say:57:1064303039:0.text:
Move it here.
Hypogean servants can help.
say:57:1064303039:0.source_cn: 搬迁，即可。\n役使恶魔仆从，高效生产。

say:58:1064303040:0.text: No way! You can't move your factory into dwarf territory! That's basically telling everyone there's a Hypogean here!
say:58:1064303040:0.source_cn: 不行！怎么能把一整套深渊生产线搬到矮人的地盘上！生怕别...

say:59:1064303041:0.text: Those dwarves would be on our heels in no time, especially Zanie!
say:59:1064303041:0.source_cn: 我们还比不比赛了！那群矮人老古板肯定会追着我们跑的，尤...

say:60:1064303042:0.text:
...
Okay. I'll go to the abyss.

say:61:1064303043:0.text: Gunnar raises an arm as ominous energy gathers at the muzzle of his cannon. He then points it toward an empty corner of the workshop.
say:61:1064303043:0.source_cn: 勒图姆抬起手，炮管出凝聚令人心悸的能量，对准了工坊内一...

say:62:1064303044:0.text: With an ear-splitting roar, a sinister portal leading to the Abyss rips open.
say:62:1064303044:0.source_cn: 刺耳的撕裂声响起，一道散发着黑暗气息的深渊通道开启。

say:65:1064303046:0.text: With that, Gunnar plunges into the portal. The portal shudders violently, but remains partially open.
say:65:1064303046:0.source_cn: 勒图姆说完，身体没入深渊通道。通道剧烈地波动了一下，并...

say:66:1064303047:0.text: Hey, Gunnar!!! Get back here! You should've talked to me before opening that portal! You're driving me crazy! Ugh!
say:66:1064303047:0.source_cn: 喂？！勒图姆！给我回来！你怎么不商量一下，就把深渊通道...

say:68:1064303048:0.text: L-Lady Kulu, what now? The portal's still open...
say:68:1064303048:0.source_cn: 库、库露露大人，现在怎么办？深渊通道还没有完全关闭……

say:69:1064303049:0.text: Kulu's communicator starts ringing as she frantically tries to shut the portal.
say:69:1064303049:0.source_cn: 库露露手忙脚乱地试图封住深渊通道，不合时宜的是，魔法通...

say:73:1064303050:0.text: Where have you been all morning, little girl? And where's that mysterious contestant...
say:73:1064303050:0.source_cn: 小丫头，怎么一上午都没见到你。还有那个神秘的参赛者，他在……

say:78:1064303051:0.text: S-So good to hear from you, Zanie! I-I'm just... taking care of Boomboom!
say:78:1064303051:0.source_cn: 哎、哎呀呀！是祖娅阿姨啊！我、我没跑哪去！是阿爆！

say:79:1064303052:0.text: Boomboom came down with a nasty stomachache after eating a damp cannonball yesterday!
say:79:1064303052:0.source_cn: 阿爆它昨天吃……吃了一颗受潮的炮弹，一直闹肚子，我正在...

say:82:1064303053:0.text: Ugh... Lady Kulu's right... That cannonball... tasted kind of funny... My tummy... won't stop churning...
say:82:1064303053:0.source_cn: 唔……库露露大人说得对……昨天那颗炮弹，味道怪怪的……...

say:85:1064303054:0.text: See? Boomboom's really sick! I have to look after him, or he could go off at any second!
say:85:1064303054:0.source_cn: 对对对！你看，它都这样了！我得照顾它，万一它忍不住爆炸...

say:86:1064303055:0.text: D-Don't worry about me. Talk to you later!
say:86:1064303055:0.source_cn: 那个那个，祖娅阿姨你先忙，我这边走不开，先挂了。

say:87:1064303056:0.text: Aaaagh! This is ridiculous! Why do I have to pick up the pieces after that Metalhead?!
say:87:1064303056:0.source_cn: 啊啊啊啊——真是麻烦死了！都是那个铁块头害的！

narration:88:1064303057:0.text: Inside Workshop Eight, the hastily sealed portal continues to leak abyssal energy, while a frazzled Kulu is struggling to hold everything together...
narration:88:1064303057:0.source_cn: 工坊内，只留下被紧急封闭，却仍在渗出深渊气息的通道，以...

say:5:1064304002:0.text:
A loud noise rips through the morning, yanking Kulu from deep sleep.
Still bleary-eyed, Kulu turns toward the noise only to find the abyssal portal gaping open...
say:5:1064304002:0.source_cn: 黎明时分，一声巨响吵醒了酣睡的库露露。\n迷迷糊糊中，...

say:9:1064304003:0.text: Gunnar leaps from the portal, a menacing spear slung across his back.
say:9:1064304003:0.source_cn: 勒图姆从中跃出，他的背部，携着一把造型狂野、散发着危险...

say:11:1064304005:0.source_cn: 火力实验，成功。\n尖端构造。

say:15:1064304008:0.text: Gunnar?! You rascal! Do you even know what you've put me through?!
say:15:1064304008:0.source_cn: 你——你你你还知道回来，你知不知道你干了什么？！

say:16:1064304009:1.text: You opened the portal and ran off! Do you know how hard it was for me to seal it up?!
say:16:1064304009:1.source_cn: 居然就那样开个门跑掉了！留下个破洞给我！你知道我费了多...

say:17:1064304010:1.text: What if something monstrous had come pouring out?! I can't even imagine what a disaster that would've been!
say:17:1064304010:1.source_cn: 万一那个破洞里出来什么乱七八糟的东西……导致这边的人啊...

say:19:1064304011:1.text: Lady Kulu lost a whole night's sleep over this! You should be ashamed of yourself!
say:19:1064304011:1.source_cn: 没错！库露露大人忧心忡忡，一整晚都没有休息好！始作俑者...

say:20:1064304012:0.text:
A disaster.
What's wrong with that?

say:22:1064304014:0.text: While Kulu is beside herself with fury, something seems to occur to Gunnar, and he quickly changes his tune...
say:22:1064304014:0.source_cn: 就在库露露生气得说不出话时，勒图姆似乎想到了什么，转而...

say:23:1064304015:0.text:
I put the abyss at risk of corruption.
I overlooked that.
say:23:1064304015:0.source_cn: 锻造赛进行时，深渊，存有污染风险。\n我的疏忽。

say:24:1064304016:0.text: Wow, you're even more flip-floppy than me! But you're missing the point! This has nothing to do with corruption and everything to do with the trouble you've caused me!
say:24:1064304016:0.source_cn: 哎、哎呀，怎么比本大人还善变！不是影响锻造的事，是会给...

say:25:1064304017:0.text: Gunnar lets out a noncommittal grunt while shifting his attention to his spear.
say:25:1064304017:0.source_cn: 勒图姆不置可否，只回应了一个模糊的词语，注意力完全被长...

say:27:1064304018:0.text:
New runes. Energy infused.
To be tested again.
say:27:1064304018:0.source_cn: 全新魔纹，能量灌注。\n火力，亟需验证。

say:28:1064304019:0.text: Hmph... I give up. Talking to you is like talking to a wall.
say:28:1064304019:0.source_cn: 呃……算啦算啦，跟你这个脑子里只有火力的家伙说不清。

say:29:1064304020:0.text: That's it, I'm going back to bed. Wake me up when the contest starts at noon!
say:29:1064304020:0.source_cn: 我要补觉啦，等中午比赛开始了再叫醒我吧！

say:33:1064304021:0.text: Ladies and gentlemen, are you ready? Let's take a look at the masterpiece from Workshop Eight!
say:33:1064304021:0.source_cn: 女士们，先生们！接下来，将是第八号，神秘锻造大师的作品展示！

say:34:1064304022:0.text: Will his remarkable run continue against the odds?
say:34:1064304022:0.source_cn: 他会再一次延续第一轮的好运嘛？还是，不出意外地输掉比赛呢？

say:35:1064304023:0.text:
It's time for his creation to speak for itself!
The Annihilator!
say:35:1064304023:0.source_cn: 让我们，把目光聚焦到他的作品：\n附——魔——长——枪...

say:37:1064304024:0.text: Ramsey walks onto the stage with visible apprehension. Taking a deep breath, he grips the spear firmly with both hands.
say:37:1064304024:0.source_cn: 工作人员拉齐有些紧张地走上展示台，他深呼吸一口气，双手...

say:38:1064304025:0.text: The runes on the spear flash briefly. Then, nothing happens.
say:38:1064304025:0.source_cn: 长枪上的魔纹亮了一下，随即熄灭，什么也没有发生。

say:41:1064304026:0.text: ... Did the enchantment fail? Was it the runes?
say:41:1064304026:0.source_cn: ……失败了？难道是附魔出问题了？

say:43:1064304027:0.text: Well, his lucky streak had to end sometime. There's no shame in losing to Bowa.
say:43:1064304027:0.source_cn: 我就说嘛，运气总有用完的时候。不过，输给博瓦也不算什么...

say:44:1064304028:0.text:
Ramsey makes another attempt to activate the runes, yet the spear shows no reaction.
The crowd grows restless, with murmurs and occasional boos rippling through the stands...
say:44:1064304028:0.source_cn: 拉齐再次尝试启动魔纹，长枪依旧毫无反应。\n就在观众席...

say:45:1064304029:0.text: Without warning, the spear convulses violently, letting out a shrill hum!
say:45:1064304029:0.source_cn: 剧变骤然发生，长枪开始剧烈地震动，发出刺耳的嗡鸣！

say:48:1064304030:0.text: Ramsey, let it go! Everyone, get down! Now!
say:48:1064304030:0.source_cn: 拉齐，快松手！所有人趴下，危险！

say:50:1064304031:0.text: Zanie activates the protective barrier just in time to prevent any mishaps.
say:50:1064304031:0.source_cn: 祖娅反应迅速，在意外发生前，抢先激活了看台旁的防护装置。

say:51:1064304032:0.text: The next instant, the spearhead blazes like an incandescent star, unleashing a burst of blinding light. A tsunami of magical energy sweeps through the air.
say:51:1064304032:0.source_cn: 下一秒，枪尖如烧红的星辰一般，迸发出刺眼的亮光。一股魔...

say:54:1064304033:0.text:
*Kaboom*!!!
The target for the weapon test disintegrates into nothingness, and even the stage is blown to pieces!
say:54:1064304033:0.source_cn: 砰——砰——砰——\n用于测试武器威力的标靶瞬间汽化，...

say:55:1064304034:1.text: The protective barrier shudders under the impact, flickering wildly as cracks race across its surface. If not for Zanie's quick reaction, even the audience wouldn't have been spared!
say:55:1064304034:1.source_cn: 防护光罩剧烈闪烁、布满裂纹，所幸祖娅反应及时，恐怕连看...

say:56:1064304035:0.text:
After some time, the dust gradually settles, but the audience remains stunned by the spectacle.
Their shock soon gives way to excitement, however, as the thrill of witnessing such overwhelming power outweighs any lingering fear.
say:56:1064304035:0.source_cn: 烟尘渐渐散去，观众们惊魂未定。\n寂静并未持续太久，对...

say:59:1064304036:0.text: Goodness gracious... I've never seen anything... this powerful.
say:59:1064304036:0.source_cn: 天哪……这恐怖的威力……太、太厉害了。

say:60:1064304037:0.text: I-I take back everything I said before... By the way, where's Workshop Eight? I want the craftsman's autograph...
say:60:1064304037:0.source_cn: 我、我收回我之前的话……话说八号工坊在哪，我能不能过去...

say:61:1064304038:0.text: This is outright murder! Set all safety measures to maximum right now!
say:61:1064304038:0.source_cn: 胡闹，这简直是谋杀！武器的威力完全超出了安全极限！防护...

say:64:1064304039:0.text: Should we even continue the competition? A warehouse explosion on day one, and now the stage is destroyed. This is getting out of hand...
say:64:1064304039:0.source_cn: 这比赛还要继续吗？才两天，就炸了一次仓库，又毁了一次看...

say:65:1064304040:1.text: And both incidents trace back to that mysterious guy from Workshop Eight. Just who is he?
say:65:1064304040:1.source_cn: 未必是意外。两次了，都与第八号工坊那个神秘的家伙有关，...

say:66:1064304041:0.text: Ah... Kulu seems close to him. Let me ask her what she knows.
say:66:1064304041:0.source_cn: 对了……库露露好像和他走得很近，得找她问问话。

narration:68:1064304042:0.text: Zanie fishes out her communicator and tries to contact Kulu...
narration:68:1064304042:0.source_cn: 祖娅拿出魔法通讯器，尝试联络库露露……

say:70:1064304043:0.text: Kulu ignores her ringing communicator. Instead, she stares at the pandemonium at the contest site, her face clouded with irritation...
say:70:1064304043:0.source_cn: 库露露手中的通讯器持续响动，她没有立刻接听，而是望着会...

say:74:1064304045:0.source_cn: 库露露大人，好像有通讯……

say:75:1064304046:0.text: Yeah, yeah, I know! Ugh, my head's splitting! It was a huge mistake letting this guy in...
say:75:1064304046:0.source_cn: 知道了知道了！唔，头好痛，就不该把这家伙带进来……

say:76:1064304047:0.text: Kulu takes a deep breath before answering the communicator...
say:76:1064304047:0.source_cn: 库露露深吸一口气，接起通讯器……

say:77:1064304048:0.text: Hey, Zanie! W-What's going on at the stage? I was just about to head over there.
say:77:1064304048:0.source_cn: 喂？祖娅，我、我正准备去看热闹呢。

say:81:1064304049:0.text: Kulu, be honest with me. Who's that mysterious guy you brought in? His spear almost blew the whole place up!
say:81:1064304049:0.source_cn: 库露露，老实交代，你带来那个人到底什么来头，他的武器差...

say:86:1064304050:0.source_cn: 我、我刚才也被吓到了好吧！

say:87:1064304051:0.text: Your staff must've messed up! O-Or maybe the weapon is just so advanced that they had no idea how to use it!
say:87:1064304051:0.source_cn: 肯定是测试员操作不当！或、或者是武器太先进了，他们不会用！

say:92:1064304052:0.text: Drop the act, little girl. I don't have time to come after you right now.
say:92:1064304052:0.source_cn: 少和我打马虎眼，小丫头，我现在没功夫去找你。

say:93:1064304053:0.text: If you two pull anything again, I won't be so forgiving next time.
say:93:1064304053:0.source_cn: 要是你俩再搞事，惹出什么不得了的乱子，我绝对不会饶过你。

say:103:1064304055:0.text: Hey, why are you crying? I just don't want anything bad to happen. Fine, maybe my tone was a bit harsh.
say:103:1064304055:0.source_cn: 欸欸，怎么还哭起来了，我这不是给你提个醒嘛，就是语气重了点。

say:104:1064304056:0.text:
There, there, stop crying. Forget what I said just now.
If you ever need help, just come find me, alright?
say:104:1064304056:0.source_cn: 好了好了，别哭了，我收回刚才的话。\n不过，你要是真遇...

say:107:1064304057:0.text: Gunnar's tendency to cause trouble puts Kulu on edge. She has a bad feeling that if he continues competing, something even worse will happen.
say:107:1064304057:0.source_cn: 勒图姆接二连三闹出事情，让库露露十分烦闷。她总觉得，要...

say:108:1064304058:0.text: So, Kulu decides to <style="highlight">stop Gunnar at all costs</style>, even if it means looking a little less cool.

say:1:1064305001:0.text: After a night of urgent repairs, the contest venue reopens the following afternoon, with the protective barrier around the stands reinforced.
say:1:1064305001:0.source_cn: 经过连夜抢修，比赛会场于当日下午再度开放，看台四周的防...

say:2:1064305002:0.text: Palpable excitement ripples through the audience. Gonrad takes the stage, feeding off their energy and amplifying it with every move.
say:2:1064305002:0.source_cn: 观众们的表情中流露出期待与难以掩饰的紧张，主持人冈罗站...

say:4:1064305003:0.text:
Ladies and gentlemen, after two rounds of heart-pounding—
Or should I say, explosive—matches, the much-awaited grand finals are here!
say:4:1064305003:0.source_cn: 女士们！先生们！历经两轮惊心动魄、精彩绝伦——\n或者...

say:5:1064305004:0.text: In this final showdown, two master craftsmen will demonstrate the pinnacle of weapon forging!
say:5:1064305004:0.source_cn: 两位技艺登峰造极的大师，将在决赛，为我们呈现何为最强武...

say:6:1064305005:0.text:
Our first finalist is Kornuk, known for his robust craftsmanship!
Next up, we have the mysterious contestant from Workshop Eight! His creations have quite literally blown us away!
say:6:1064305005:0.source_cn: 他们分别是——以厚重与力量著称的矮人锻造大师，寇恩！\...

say:7:1064305006:0.text: The audience bursts into rapturous cheers, much louder than those for Kornuk.
say:7:1064305006:0.source_cn: 观众席爆发出狂热的声浪，八号的呼喊声明显要高于寇恩。

say:8:1064305007:0.text: The rules for the finals are all about simplicity. Finalists, you have one day to forge your creations, with no restrictions on materials, design, or weapon type!
say:8:1064305007:0.source_cn: 决赛规则，极致纯粹！限时一天，材料、形式、种类无限制！

say:9:1064305008:0.text: Draw upon everything you have learned and forge your ultimate weapon!
say:9:1064305008:0.source_cn: 请两位大师，倾尽你们的智慧与技艺，锻造出你们心目中，那...

say:10:1064305009:0.text:
Tomorrow, right here, one of you will be crowned the champion!
Let the finals begin!
say:10:1064305009:0.source_cn: 明天，依然在这片会场，将角逐出最强武器锻造大师！\n比...

say:14:1064305010:0.text: Hey, Metalhead, heard that? You're free to make whatever you want in the finals. That's right up your alley!
say:14:1064305010:0.source_cn: 喂，铁块头！决赛题目你听到了吧，无限制，是不是正合你意。

say:15:1064305011:0.text: Whatever nightmare you create this time, I won't back an eyelid!
say:15:1064305011:0.source_cn: 这次，无论你想做什么武器，我都已经完全过敏了。

say:17:1064305012:0.text: No offense, Lady Kulu, but don't you mean "bat" an eyelid?
say:17:1064305012:0.source_cn: 库露露大人想说的应该是，脱敏吧?

say:19:1064305013:0.text: Uh... w-whatever! You know what I mean!

say:20:1064305014:0.text:
Ultimate weapon.
Doomstar. My finest cannon.
say:20:1064305014:0.source_cn: 最强武器。\n终极大炮，末日陨星。

say:21:1064305015:0.text: That's a brilliant name. I've got to say, you do have a knack for naming things.
say:21:1064305015:0.source_cn: 听起来挺气派，也够时髦。在起名字这件事上，我还是比较欣...

say:22:1064305016:0.text:
Refined abyssal energy. As core power source.
Boosts impact fivefold.
say:22:1064305016:0.source_cn: 精粹深渊之力，作核心能量。\n冲击力，五倍攀升。

say:23:1064305017:0.text:
Warhead. Crucial.
Enchanted and reforged with high-purity <style="highlight">soul crystals</style>.
say:23:1064305017:0.source_cn: 弹头，火力核心。\n以高纯度<style=highli...

say:24:1064305018:1.text:
Wait, soul crystals?! I-I'm definitely batting my eyelids now...
If I remember correctly, those crystals are made by <style="highlight">refining the souls of sentient beings</style>!
say:24:1064305018:1.source_cn: 灵魂晶石？！我、我又不脱敏了……\n没记错的话，那东西...

say:25:1064305019:1.text: Soul crystals are common in the abyss, but this is human territory! They're <style="highlight">absolutely forbidden</style> here!
say:25:1064305019:1.source_cn: 深渊下面不难搞到，但这是人类世界！<style=hig...

say:26:1064305020:1.text: If you're thinking of opening another portal to the abyss to fetch some, forget it right now!
say:26:1064305020:1.source_cn: 你该不会又想开个门回深渊去拿吧？绝对不行！上次的账还没...

say:27:1064305021:1.text:
No. I need Hypogean servants.
Too inefficient. If I transport them myself.
say:27:1064305021:1.source_cn: 不。缺少恶魔仆从。\n仅我运送，效率评估，过低。

say:28:1064305022:0.text:
Use whatever I can find. Here.
As supplies.
say:28:1064305022:0.source_cn: 人类世界，就地取材。\n以充军资。

say:30:1064305024:1.text:
Villages, towns, cities.
Humans. Renewable resource. Ample reserves.
say:30:1064305024:1.source_cn: 村，镇，城。\n人类，可再生，储量充足。

say:31:1064305025:1.text:
Special abyssal furnace. Built.
Fast extraction. For finals.
say:31:1064305025:1.source_cn: 特制深渊熔炉，已组装。\n高效提取，以备明日竞赛。

say:32:1064305026:1.text: H-Hey, humans aren't lumber! We're both Hypogeans... How can you be so ruthless?!
say:32:1064305026:1.source_cn: 你、你你你，你把人类当木材了？大家都是恶魔，你怎么能这...

say:33:1064305027:1.text:
Material sourcing. Avoid competition personnel and venue.
Final testing. Proceed as planned.
say:33:1064305027:1.source_cn: 取材，将规避比赛人员及，场地。\n确保，最终测试开展。

say:35:1064305029:1.text: Gunnar, I cut you slack because you're a fan and you actually know weapons. That changes now.
say:35:1064305029:1.source_cn: 唉，本来呢，看在你是我的粉丝，还挺懂火力的份上，我考虑...

say:36:1064305030:1.text: You've proved to me time and again that you're nothing but a hopeless weapon maniac!
say:36:1064305030:1.source_cn: 但现在，我确定了，勒图姆，你就是个无药可救、最最最老土...

say:37:1064305031:1.text:
Trying to talk sense into someone like you is the stupidest thing I've ever done!
I'm sending you back to the abyss, even if it means doing things the old-fashioned way!
say:37:1064305031:1.source_cn: 跟你这种家伙讲道理，是我这辈子做过最蠢最蠢的事！\n本...

say:38:1064305032:0.text: Zanie! Elijah! Lailah! You heard that, right? I've given up on him. He's all yours!
say:38:1064305032:0.source_cn: 祖娅！伊莱亚！莱拉！你们听到了吧，我决定不感化他了，交...

say:41:1064305033:0.text: At Kulu's cue, the trio enters the workshop. Zanie wears a grim expression, while Elijah and Lailah remain calm.
say:41:1064305033:0.source_cn: 库露露话音刚落，三人走入工坊，是面色阴沉的祖娅，还有平...

say:42:1064305034:0.text: <style="highlight">Kulu turned to them for help after Gunnar's behavior crossed the line</style>.

say:43:1064305035:0.text: Hmph, at least you came to your senses before it was too late, Kulu. I may go a little easier on you this time.
say:43:1064305035:0.source_cn: 哼哼，算你及时回头，库露露，这次可以考虑少追究你一些责任。

say:44:1064305036:0.text: Metalhead, are you seriously planning to turn the villagers into soul crystals? Over my dead body!
say:44:1064305036:0.source_cn: 铁块头，听说你要用村子里的大家做什么材料，我可不允许！

say:47:1064305037:0.text: To burn living souls as fuel is an unforgivable sin, even for Hypogeans.
say:47:1064305037:0.source_cn: 以生灵为薪柴，纵然是来自深渊的恶魔，亦为悖逆。

say:48:1064305038:0.text: Such evil intent breeds calamity. It must be stopped.
say:48:1064305038:0.source_cn: 这般恶念，实为灾厄，其行应当停止。

say:50:1064305039:0.text: Elijah and Lailah position themselves in formation. The intricate starry magic circle beneath them radiates dazzling light, enveloping the workshop in its energy!
say:50:1064305039:0.source_cn: 伊莱亚和莱拉联结站定，脚下繁复的星辰封印法阵光芒大盛，...

say:53:1064305040:1.text:
Stellar energy. Pure. Efficient.
Excellent energy source. Jotted down.
say:53:1064305040:1.source_cn: 星辰之力，纯净，高效。\n优质改装能量，已记录。

say:55:1064305041:0.text: Can you believe this? Even with death staring him in the face, all he can think about is weapons! Zanie! Elijah! Lailah! Get him!
say:55:1064305041:0.source_cn: 你看他！你看他！死到临头还只想着武器！祖娅，伊莱亚，莱...

say:57:1064305042:0.text: Gunnar points his cannon at Kulu and the others, ominous energy surging and converging at the barrel…
say:57:1064305042:0.source_cn: 勒图姆的炮管瞄向四人，毁灭能量沸腾汇聚……

say:58:1064305043:0.text:
Doomstar prototype.
Collect combat data samples.
say:58:1064305043:0.source_cn: 末日陨星原型机。\n收集，实战数据样本。

say:64:1064305045:0.text: Following a thunderous boom, a pillar of light surges skyward, shaking the entire Brimstone Village!
say:64:1064305045:0.source_cn: 恐怖的爆炸声和冲天而起的星辉光柱，惊动了整个深岩村！

say:65:1064305046:0.text: Gunnar's guffaw rings out through the relentless bombardment...
say:65:1064305046:0.source_cn: 勒图姆在狂轰滥炸中发出大笑，声音透过爆炸声传出……

say:67:1064305048:0.text:
This contest.
Only I. Can be the champion!
say:67:1064305048:0.source_cn: 武器锻造竞赛。\n冠军，唯我！

say:68:1064305049:1.text:
Gunnar's barrage wreaks havoc all around him.
Thanks to the combined efforts of Kulu and the others, Gunnar's power was contained within the workshop. Otherwise, the entire Brimstone Village would have been reduced to ashes.
say:68:1064305049:1.source_cn: 勒图姆的炮火肆虐轰击四周。\n所幸库露露四人合力，将勒...

say:69:1064305050:0.text: As the sky darkens, stellar energy intensifies. The magic circle slowly closes in, suppressing Gunnar and his raging firepower.
say:69:1064305050:0.source_cn: 天色渐晚，星辰之力越来越盛，封印法阵缓慢收拢，将勒图姆...

say:70:1064305051:0.text: Even as the sealing closes around him, Gunnar is still marveling at the immense power of the stellar energy. His voice drips with unbridled admiration.
say:70:1064305051:0.source_cn: 在封印完成前一刻，勒图姆仍在为星辰之力的强大力量发出赞...

say:71:1064305052:1.text:
Stellar energy. So powerful.
Data collected.
say:71:1064305052:1.source_cn: 星辰之力，强力能量。\n数据，已收集。

say:72:1064305053:1.text:
Doomstar. To be remade.
Modification plan...
say:72:1064305053:1.source_cn: 重制，究极末日陨星。\n改装方案，已……

say:74:1064305054:1.text: Before he can finish, Gunnar is dragged into a temporary abyssal rift by force. When the chaos finally subsides, only ruins remain...
say:74:1064305054:1.source_cn: 话音未落，勒图姆被强行封入临时撕开的深渊裂隙。一切平息...

say:76:1064305055:0.text: ... That crazy, obsessive fool! He was still talking about modifying his cannon at the very end!
say:76:1064305055:0.source_cn: ……这个笨蛋、疯子、偏执狂！最后喊的居然还是武器改装！

say:77:1064305056:1.text: As formidable as he and his cannon may be, he never stood a chance against the wise and mighty Lady Kulu!
say:77:1064305056:1.source_cn: 不过，在英明神武的库露露大人面前，就算是这种武器狂人，...

say:80:1064305057:0.text: Obsession, when left to fester, can give rise to a power that brings ruin to all things.
say:80:1064305057:0.source_cn: 纯粹的痴迷，可化为摧毁万物的存在。

say:81:1064305058:0.text: Only the eternal starlight can stand watch against such beings.
say:81:1064305058:0.source_cn: 对此等存在，需以永恒的星光加以警惕。

say:82:1064305059:0.text: The danger is far from over.

say:83:1064305060:0.text: The seal is only a temporary measure.

say:86:1064305061:0.text: Kulu! Next time, when you meet a stranger...

say:87:1064305062:0.text: *Crying*... Sorry, Zanie... It was my bad...
say:87:1064305062:0.source_cn: 呜……呜呜呜……对不起，祖娅……我知道错了……

say:88:1064305063:0.text: Tsk, you know I can never stay mad at you. At least the biggest trouble is out of the way for now. We can take our time cleaning up the mess.
say:88:1064305063:0.source_cn: 唉，真是拿你没办法，所幸最大的麻烦暂时送走了。剩下的烂...

say:90:1064305064:0.text: Beneath the night sky, Brimstone Village echoes with the cries of survivors and hushed words of consolation in the wake of the disaster...
say:90:1064305064:0.source_cn: 夜空下，深岩村回荡起劫后余生的哭泣与慰问……

say:91:1064305065:0.text: Over time, Gunnar's story evolves into multiple versions, shared and retold in taverns, at docks, and in workshops...
say:91:1064305065:0.source_cn: 随时间流逝，勒图姆的恐怖传说演变为各种版本，在酒馆、码...
